decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The Indonesian answer is appropriate. Malaysian “perjalanan kerja” is understandable and used, but it is not the clearest established equivalent for “business trip”; DBP recommends “lawatan kerja,” while “perjalanan perniagaan” is a formal alternative. Therefore the answer pair and “different-common-word” relation overstate a clean Indonesian–Malaysian contrast. No false-friend contrast is present. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
